dn27:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāra-mātu pāsāde.
dn27:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Vāseṭṭha-Bhāradvājā bhikkhūsu parivasanti bhikkhubhāvaṃ ākaṅkhamānā.
dn27:1.4: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito pāsādā orohitvā pāsādapacchāyāyaṃ abbhokāse caṅkamati. 2.
dn27:2.1: Addasā kho Vāseṭṭho Bhagavantaṃ sāyaṇha-samayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhitaṃ pāsādā orohitvā pāsāda- pacchāyāyaṃ abbhokāse caṅkamantaṃ.
dn27:2.3: ‘Ayaṃ āvuso Bhāradvāja Bhagavā sāyaṇha-samayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito pāsādā orohitvā pāsāda-pacchāyāyaṃ abbhokāse caṅkamati.
dn27:2.4: Āyām' āvuso Bhāradvāja yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamissāma.
dn27:2.5: App eva nāma labheyyāma Bhagavato santikā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti.'
dn27:2.6: ‘Evam āvuso ti' kho Bhāradvājo Vāseṭṭhassa paccassosi.
dn27:2.7: Atha kho Vāseṭṭha-Bhāradvājā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā Bhagavantaṃ caṅkamantaṃ anucaṅkamiṃsu. 3.
dn27:3.2: ‘Tumhe khv attha Vāseṭṭha brāhmaṇa-jaccā brāhmaṇakulīnā brāhmaṇa-kulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā. Kacci vo Vāseṭṭha brāhmaṇā na akkosanti na paribhāsantīti?'
dn27:3.3: ‘Taggha no bhante brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti atta-rūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no aparipuṇṇāyāti.'
dn27:3.4: ‘Yathā-kathaṃ pana vo Vāseṭṭha brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti atta-rūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no aparipuṇṇāyāti?'
dn27:3.6: "Brāhmaṇo va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo;
dn27:3.7: brāhmaṇo va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo;
dn27:3.9: brāhmaṇā va Brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā Brahma-jā Brahma-nimmitā Brahma-dāyādā.
dn27:3.10: Te tumhe seṭṭhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ hitvā hīnam attha vaṇṇaṃ ajjhūpagatā , yadidaṃ muṇḍake samaṇake ibbhe kaṇhe bandhupādāpacce.
dn27:3.11: Tayidaṃ na sādhu, tayidaṃ nappatirūpaṃ, yaṃ tumhe seṭṭhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ hitvā hīnam attha vaṇṇaṃ ajjhūpagatā, yadidaṃ muṇḍake samaṇake ibbhe kaṇhe bandhu-pādāpacce ti."
dn27:3.12: Evaṃ kho no bhante brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti atta-rūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no aparipuṇṇāyāti.' 4.
dn27:4.1: ‘Taggha vo Vāseṭṭha brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ assarantā evam āhaṃsu:
dn27:4.2: "Brāhmaṇo va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo;
dn27:4.3: brāhmaṇo va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo;
dn27:4.5: brāhmaṇā va Brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā Brahma-jā Brahmanimmitā Brahma-dāyādā" ti.
dn27:4.6: Dissanti kho pana Vāseṭṭha brāhmaṇānaṃ brāhmaṇiyo utuniyo pi gabbhiniyo pi vijāyamānā pi pāyamānā pi,
dn27:4.7: te ca brāhmaṇā yonijā va samānā evam āhaṃsu:
dn27:4.12: Te Brahmānañ c' eva abbhācikkhanti musā ca bhāsanti bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavanti.' 5.
dn27:5.3: Khattiyo pi kho Vāseṭṭha idh' ekacco pāṇātipāti hoti, adinnādāyi hoti, kāmesu micchā-cāri hoti, musā-vādi hoti, pisuṇā-vāco hoti, pharusā-vāco hoti, samphappalāpī hoti, abhijjhālū hoti, vyāpanna-citto hoti, micchā-diṭṭhi hoti.
dn27:5.4: Iti kho Vāseṭṭha ye 'me dhammā akusalā akusala-saṃkhātā, sāvajjā sāvajja-saṃkhātā, asevitabbā asevitabba-saṃkhātā, nālam-ariyā nālam-ariyasaṅkhātā, kaṇhā kaṇha-vipākā viññū-garahitā, Khattiye pi te idh' ekacce sandissanti.
dn27:5.7: Suddo pi kho Vāseṭṭha idh' ekacco pāṇātipāti . . . pe . . . micchādiṭṭhi hoti.
dn27:5.8: Iti kho Vāseṭṭha ye 'me dhammā akusalā akusala-saṃkhāta . . . pe . . .
dn27:5.10: Sudde pi te idh' ekacce sandissanti. 6.
dn27:6.1: ‘Khattiyo pi kho Vāseṭṭha idh' ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musā-vādā paṭivirato hoti, pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, anabhijjhālū hoti, avyāpannacitto hoti, sammā-diṭṭhi hoti.
dn27:6.2: Iti kho Vāseṭṭha ye 'me dhammā kusalā kusala-saṃkhātā anavajjā anavajja-saṃkhātā sevitabbā sevitabba-saṃkhātā alam-ariyā alam-ariya-saṅkhātā sukkā sukka-vipākā viññuppasatthā, khattiye pi te idh' ekacce sandissanti.
dn27:6.5: Suddo pi kho Vāseṭṭha idh' ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti . . . pe . . .
dn27:6.6: anabhijjhālū hoti, avyāpanna-citto hoti, sammā-diṭṭhi hoti.
dn27:6.7: Iti kho Vāseṭṭha ye 'me dhammā kusalā kusalasaṃkhātā anavajjā anavajja-saṃkhātā sevitabbā sevitabbasaṃkhātā alam-ariyā alam-ariya-saṃkhātā sukkā sukkavipākā viññuppasatthā,
dn27:6.8: Sudde pi te idh' ekacce sandissanti. 7.
dn27:7.1: ‘Imesu kho Vāseṭṭha catūsu vaṇṇesu evam ubhayavokiṇṇesu vattamānesu kaṇha-sukkesu dhammesu viññūgarahitesu c' eva viññū-pasatthesu ca yad ettha brāhmaṇā evam āhaṃsu:
dn27:7.2: "Brāhmaṇo va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo;
dn27:7.3: brāhmaṇo va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo;
dn27:7.5: brāhmaṇā va Brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā Brahma-jā Brahmanimmitā Brahma-dāyādā ti" --
dn27:7.8: Imesaṃ hi Vāseṭṭha catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā kata-karaṇīyo ohita-bhāro anuppatta-sadattho parikkhīṇabhava-saṃyojano sammad-aññā vimutto, so tesaṃ aggam akkhāyati dhammen' eva no adhammena.
dn27:7.9: Dhammo hi Vāseṭṭha seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ diṭṭhe c' eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca. 8.
dn27:7.10: ‘Tadaminā p' etaṃ Vāseṭṭha pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā dhammo seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ diṭṭhe c' eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca.
dn27:8.3: Sakyā kho pana Vāseṭṭha rañño Pasenadi-Kosalassa anuyuttā bhavanti.
dn27:8.4: Karonti kho Vāseṭṭha Sakyā raññe Pasenadimhi Kosale nipaccakāraṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīci-kammaṃ.
dn27:8.5: Iti kho Vāseṭṭha yaṃ karonti Sakyā raññe Pasenadimhi Kosale nipaccakāraṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjali-kammaṃ sāmīci-kammaṃ, karoti taṃ rājā Pasenadi-Kosalo Tathāgate nipaccakāraṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjali-kammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ -- "Nanu sujāto Samaṇo Gotamo? Dujjāto 'ham asmi;
dn27:8.9: Atha kho taṃ dhammaṃ yeva sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno, evaṃ rājā Pasenadi-Kosalo Tathāgate nipaccakāraṃ karoti abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīci-kammaṃ.
dn27:8.10: Iminā kho etaṃ Vāseṭṭha pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā dhammo seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ diṭṭhe c' eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca. 9.
dn27:9.1: ‘Tumhe khv attha Vāseṭṭha nānā-jaccā nānā-nāmā nānā-gottā nānā-kulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā.
dn27:9.2: "Ke tumhe ti?" puṭṭhā samānā, "Samaṇā Sakya-puttiy' amhāti " paṭijānātha.
dn27:9.3: Yassa kho pan' assa Vāseṭṭha Tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā mūla-jātā patiṭṭhitā daḷhā asaṃhārikā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ, tass' etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya:
dn27:9.4: "Bhagavato 'mhi putto oraso mukhato jāto dhamma-jo dhamma-nimmito dhamma-dāyādo" ti.
dn27:9.6: Tathāgatassa h' etaṃ Vāseṭṭha adhivacanaṃ -- "Dhamma-kāyo iti pi Brahma-kāyo iti pi, Dhamma-bhūto iti pi Brahma-bhūto iti pīti." 10.
dn27:10.1: ‘Hoti kho so Vāseṭṭha samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati.
dn27:10.2: Saṃvaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā Ābhassara-saṃvaṭṭanikā honti.
dn27:10.3: Te tattha honti manomayā pīti-bhakkhā sayampabhā antalikkha-carā subhaṭṭhāyino ciram dīgham addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
dn27:10.4: Hoti kho so Vāseṭṭha samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko vivaṭṭati.
dn27:10.5: Vivaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā Ābhassarakāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchanti.
dn27:10.6: Te ca honti manomayā pīti-bhakkhā sayam-pabhā antalikkha-carā subhaṭṭhāyino, ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti. 11.
dn27:11.1: ‘Ekodakī-bhūtaṃ kho pana Vāseṭṭha tena samayena hoti andha-kāro andhakāra-timisā.
dn27:11.2: Na candima-suriyā paññāyanti, na nakkhattāni tāraka-rūpāni paññāyanti, na rattin-divā paññāyanti, na māsaddha-māsā paññāyanti, na utu-saṃvaccharā paññāyanti, na itthi-pumā paññāyanti. Sattā sattā tv eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti.
dn27:11.3: Atha kho tesaṃ Vāseṭṭha sattānaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena rasa-paṭhavī udakasmiṃ samatāni.
dn27:11.4: Seyyathā pi nāma payaso tattassa nibbāyamānassa upari santānakaṃ hoti,
dn27:11.6: Sā ahosi vaṇṇa-sampannā gandha-sampannā rasa-sampannā, seyyathā pi nāma sampannaṃ vā sappi, sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ, evaṃ vaṇṇā ahosi;
dn27:11.10: "Ambho kim ev' idaṃ bhavissatīti?" rasa-paṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyi.
dn27:11.11: Tassa rasa-paṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyato acchādesi, taṇhā c' assa okkami.
dn27:11.12: Aññatare pi kho Vāseṭṭha sattā tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamānā rasa-paṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyiṃsu.
dn27:11.13: Tesaṃ rasa-paṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyataṃ acchādesi, taṇhā ca tesaṃ okkami .
dn27:12.1: Atha kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā rasa-paṭhaviṃ hatthehi ālumpa-kārakaṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ.
dn27:12.2: Yato kho Vāseṭṭha sattā rasa-paṭhaviṃ hatthehi ālumpakārakaṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ,
dn27:12.5: Candimasuriyesu pātu-bhūtesu, nakkhattāni tāraka-rūpāni pātur ahaṃsu.
dn27:12.6: Nakkhattesu tāraka-rūpesu pātu bhūtesu, rattindivā paññāyiṃsu.
dn27:12.9: Ettāvatā kho Vāseṭṭha ayaṃ loko puna vivaṭṭo hoti. 13.
dn27:13.1: ‘Atha kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā rasa-pathaviṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tad- āhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:13.2: Yathā yathā kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā rasapaṭhaviṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tad- āhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ kharattañ c' eva kāyasmiṃ okkami, vaṇṇa-vevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha.
dn27:13.3: Ek' idaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ek' idaṃ dubbaṇṇā.
dn27:13.4: Tattha ye te sattā vaṇṇavanto, te dubbaṇṇe satte atimaññanti, --
dn27:13.5: "Mayam etehi vaṇṇavantatarā, amheh' ete dubbaṇṇatarā ti."
dn27:13.10: Tad etarahi pi manussā kiñcid eva sādhu rasaṃ labhitvā evam āhaṃsu,
dn27:13.12: Tad eva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anupatanti, na tv ev' assa atthaṃ ājānanti. 14.
dn27:14.1: ‘Atha kho tesaṃ Vāseṭṭha sattānaṃ rasāya paṭhaviyā antarahitāya bhūmi-pappaṭako pātur ahosi.
dn27:14.2: Seyyathā pi nāma ahicchattako, evam evaṃ pātur ahosi.
dn27:14.3: So ahosi vaṇṇa-sampanno gandha-sampanno rasa-sampanno. Seyyathā pi nāma sampannaṃ vā sappi sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ, evaṃ-vaṇṇo ahosi.
dn27:14.4: Seyyathā pi nāma khuddaṃ madhuṃ aneḷakaṃ, evam assādo ahosi.
dn27:14.5: Atha kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā bhūmi-pappaṭakaṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ.
dn27:14.6: Te taṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:14.7: Yathā yathā kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā bhūmi-pappaṭakaṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tad-āhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ bhiyyoso-mattāya kharattañ c' eva kāyasmiṃ okkami, vaṇṇa-vevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha.
dn27:14.8: Ek' idaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ek' idaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.
dn27:14.9: Tattha ye te sattā vaṇṇavanto, te dubbaṇṇe satte atimaññanti, --
dn27:14.10: "Mayam etehi vaṇṇavantatarā, amheh' ete dubbaṇṇatarā ti."
dn27:14.13: Bhūmi-pappaṭake antarahite badālatā pātur ahosi. Seyyathā pi nāma kalambukā, evam evaṃ pātur ahosi.
dn27:14.14: Sā ahosi vaṇṇasampannā gandha-sampannā rasa-sampannā. Seyyathā pi nāma sampannaṃ vā sappi sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ, evaṃ-vaṇṇā ahosi.
dn27:14.15: Seyyathā pi nāma khudda-madhuaneḷakaṃ, evam assādā ahosi. 15.
dn27:15.1: ‘Atha kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā badālataṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ.
dn27:15.2: Te tam paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tad-āhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:15.3: Yathā yathā kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā badālataṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tad-āhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu , tathā-tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ bhiyyoso-mattāya kharattañ c' eva kāyasmiṃ okkami vaṇṇa-vevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha.
dn27:15.4: Ek' idaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ek' idaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.
dn27:15.5: Tattha ye te sattā vaṇṇavanto, te dubbaṇṇe satte atimaññanti, --
dn27:15.6: "Mayam etehi vaṇṇavantatarā, amheh' ete dubbaṇṇatarā ti."
dn27:15.9: -"Ahu vata no, ahāyi vata no badālatā ti."
dn27:15.10: Tad etarahi pi manussā kenacid eva dukkha-dhammena puṭṭhā evam āhaṃsu:
dn27:15.11: "Ahu vata no, ahāyi vata no ti."
dn27:15.12: Tad eva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anupatanti, na tv ev' assa atthaṃ ājānanti. 16.
dn27:16.1: ‘Atha kho tesaṃ Vāseṭṭha sattānaṃ badālatāya antarahitāya akaṭṭha-pāko sāli pātur ahosi, akaṇo athuso sugandho taṇḍula-pphalo.
dn27:16.2: Yan taṃ sāyaṃ sāyam-āsāya āharanti, pāto taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ.
dn27:16.3: Yan taṃ pāto pātar-āsāya āharanti sāyaṃ taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ,
dn27:16.5: Atha kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā akaṭṭha-pākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:16.7: Yathā yathā kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā akaṭṭha-pākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tad- āhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ bhiyyoso-mattāya kharattañ c' eva kāyasmiṃ okkami, vaṇṇa-vevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha. Itthiyā ca itthi-liṅgaṃ pātur ahosi, purisassa purisa-liṅgaṃ.
dn27:16.8: Itthī ca sudaṃ ativelaṃ purisaṃ upanijjhāyati, puriso ca itthiṃ.
dn27:16.9: Tesaṃ ativelaṃ aññam aññaṃ upanijjhāyataṃ sārāgo udapādi, pariḷāho kāyasmiṃ okkami.
dn27:16.11: Ye kho pana te Vāseṭṭha tena samayena sattā passanti methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevante, aññe paṃsuṃ khipanti, aññe seṭṭhiṃ khipanti, aññe gomayaṃ khipanti, --
dn27:16.13: Kathaṃ hi nāma satto sattassa evarūpaṃ karissatīti?"
dn27:16.14: Tad etarahi pi manussā ekaccesu janapadesu vadhuyā nibbuyhamānāya aññe paṃsuṃ khipanti, aññe seṭṭhim khipanti, aññe gomayaṃ khipanti.
dn27:16.15: Tad eva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anupatanti, na tv ev' assa atthaṃ ājānanti. 17.
dn27:17.1: ‘Adhamma-sammataṃ kho pana Vāseṭṭha tena samayena hoti, tad etarahi dhamma-sammataṃ.
dn27:17.2: Ye kho pana Vāseṭṭha tena samayena sattā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti, te māsam pi dve-māsam pi na labhanti gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisituṃ.
dn27:17.3: Yato kho Vāseṭṭha te sattā tasmiṃ samaye asaddhamme ativelaṃ pātavyataṃ āpajjiṃsu,
dn27:17.4: atha agārāni upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ tass' eva asaddhammassa paṭicchādanatthaṃ.
dn27:17.5: Atha kho Vāseṭṭha aññatarassa sattassa alasa-jātikassa etad ahosi:
dn27:17.6: "Ambho kim evāhaṃ vihaññāmi sāliṃ āharanto sāyaṃ sāyam-āsāya pāto pātar-āsāya?
dn27:17.7: Yannūnāhaṃ sāliṃ āhareyyaṃ sakid eva sāya-pātar-āsāyāti."
dn27:17.8: Atha kho so Vāseṭṭha satto sāliṃ āhāsi sakid eva sāya-pātar-āsāya.
dn27:17.9: Atha kho Vāseṭṭha aññataro satto yena so satto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ sattaṃ etad avoca:
dn27:17.11: "Alaṃ bho satta āhato me sāli sakid eva sāya-pātar-āsāyāti."
dn27:17.12: Atha kho so Vāseṭṭha satto tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi sakid eva dvīhāya, "Evam pi kira bho sādhūti."
dn27:17.13: Atha kho Vāseṭṭha aññataro satto yena so satto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ sattaṃ etad avoca:
dn27:17.15: "Alaṃ bho satta āhato me sāli sakid eva dvīhāyāti."
dn27:17.16: Atha kho so Vāseṭṭha satto tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi sakid eva catuhāya, "Evam pi kira bho sādhūti."
dn27:17.17: Atha kho Vāseṭṭha aññataro satto yena so satto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ sattaṃ etad avoca:
dn27:17.19: "Alaṃ bho satta āhato me sāli sakid eva catuhāyāti."
dn27:17.20: Atha kho so Vāseṭṭha satto tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi sakid eva aṭṭhāhāya, "Evam pi kira bho sādhūti."
dn27:17.21: Yato kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā sannidhi-kārakaṃ sāliṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ,
dn27:17.22: atha kaṇo pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhi, thuso pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhi,
dn27:17.23: lūnam pi nappaṭivirūḷhaṃ apadānaṃ paññāyittha, saṇḍa-saṇḍā sāliyo aṭṭhaṃsu. 18.
dn27:18.1: ‘Atha kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā sannipatiṃsu, sannipatitvā anutthuniṃsu, --
dn27:18.2: "Pāpakā vata bho dhammā sattesu pātu bhūtā, mayaṃ
dn27:18.3: hi pubbe manomayā ahumha pītibhakkhā sayam-pabhā antalikkha-carā subhaṭṭhāyino, ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhamha.
dn27:18.4: Tesaṃ no amhākaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena rasa-paṭhavī udakasmiṃ samatāni.
dn27:18.6: Te mayaṃ rasa-pathaviṃ hatthehi ālumpa-kārakaṃ upakkamimha paribhuñjituṃ, tesaṃ no rasa-paṭhaviṃ hatthehi ālumpa-kārakaṃ upakkamataṃ paribhuñjituṃ sayam-pabhā antaradhāyi. 12
dn27:18.7: Sayam-pabhāya antarahitāya, candima-suriyā pātur ahaṃsu. Candima-suriyesu pātu bhūtesu nakkhattāni tāraka-rūpāni pātur ahaṃsu. Nakkhattesu tāraka-rūpesu pātu bhūtesu rattiṃ-divā paññāyiṃsu. Rattiṃ-divesu paññāyamānesu māsaddha-māsā paññāyiṃsu.
dn27:18.9: Te mayaṃ rasa-paṭhaviṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhamha,
dn27:18.10: tesaṃ no pāpakānaṃ ñeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātu-bhāvā rasapaṭhavī antaradhāyi.
dn27:18.14: Te mayaṃ taṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tad-āhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhamha.
dn27:18.15: Tesaṃ no pāpakānaṃ ñeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātu-bhāvā bhūmi-pappaṭako antaradhāyi.
dn27:18.19: Te mayaṃ taṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tad-āhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhamha.
dn27:18.20: Tesaṃ no pāpakānaṃ ñeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātu-bhāvā badālatā antaradhāyi.
dn27:18.21: Badālatāya antarahitāya akaṭṭha-pāko sāli pātur ahosi, akaṇo athuso suddho sugandho taṇḍula-pphalo.
dn27:18.22: Yan taṃ sāyaṃ sāyam-āsāya āharāma pāto taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ.
dn27:18.23: Yan taṃ pāto pātar-āsāya āharāma, sāyan taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ,
dn27:18.25: Te mayaṃ akaṭṭha-pākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā tam-bhakkhā tad-āhārā ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ aṭṭhamha.
dn27:18.26: Tesaṃ no pāpakānaṃ ñeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātu-bhāvā kaṇo pi taṇḍulam pariyonandhi, thuso pi taṇḍulam pariyonandhi, lūnam pi na paṭivirūḷhaṃ, apadānaṃ paññāyittha, saṇḍasaṇḍā sāliyo ṭhitā.
dn27:18.27: Yan nūna mayaṃ sāliṃ vibhajeyyāma, mariyādaṃ ṭhapeyyāmāti."
dn27:18.28: ‘Atha kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā sāliṃ vibhajiṃsu, mariyādaṃ ṭhapesuṃ. 19.
dn27:19.1: ‘Atha kho Vāseṭṭha aññataro satto lolajātiko sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñji.
dn27:19.2: Tam enaṃ aggahesuṃ, gahetvā etad avocuṃ:
dn27:19.3: "Pāpakaṃ vata bho satta karosi, yatra hi nāma sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñjasi.
dn27:19.4: Mā ssu bho satta puna pi evarūpam akāsīti."
dn27:19.5: "Evaṃ bho ti" kho Vāseṭṭha so satto tesaṃ sattānaṃ paccassosi.
dn27:19.6: Dutiyam pi kho Vāseṭṭha so satto . . . pe . . .
dn27:19.7: Tatiyam pi kho Vāseṭṭha so satto sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñji.
dn27:19.8: Tam enaṃ aggahesuṃ, aggahetvā etad avocuṃ:
dn27:19.9: "Pāpakaṃ vata bho satta karosi, yatra hi nāma sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñjasi.
dn27:19.10: Mā ssu bho satta puna pi evarūpam akāsīti."
dn27:19.11: Aññe pāṇinā pahariṃsu, aññe leḍḍunā pahariṃsu, aññe daṇḍena pahariṃsu.
dn27:19.12: Tadagge kho pana Vāseṭṭha adinnādānaṃ paññāyati, garahā paññāyati, musāvādo paññāyati, daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyati. 20.
dn27:20.1: ‘Atha kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā sannipatiṃsu, sannipatitvā anutthuniṃsu, --
dn27:20.2: "Pāpakā vata bho dhammā sattesu pātu bhūtā, yatra hi nāma adinnādānaṃ paññāyissati, garahā paññāyissati, musā-vādo paññāyissati, daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyissati,
dn27:20.3: yan nūna mayaṃ ekaṃ sattaṃ sammanneyyāma. So no sammā-khīyitabbaṃ khīyeyya, samma-garahitabbaṃ garaheyya, sammā-pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājeyya.
dn27:20.4: Mayaṃ pan' assa sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anuppadassāmāti."
dn27:20.5: Atha kho te Vāseṭṭha sattā yo nesaṃ satto abhirūpataro ca dassanīyataro ca pāsādikataro ca mahesakkhataro ca, taṃ sattaṃ upasaṃkamitvā etad avocuṃ:
dn27:20.6: "Ehi bho satta, sammā-khīyitabbaṃ khīyi, sammā-garahitabbaṃ garahi, sammā-pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājehi.
dn27:20.7: Mayaṃ pana te sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anuppadassāmāti."
dn27:20.8: "Evaṃ bho ti" kho Vāseṭṭha so satto tesaṃ sattānaṃ paṭissutvā, sammā-khīyitabbaṃ khīyi, sammā-garahitabbaṃ garahi, sammā-pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājesi.
dn27:20.9: Te pan' assa sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anuppadaṃsu. 21.
dn27:21.1: ‘Mahājana-sammato ti kho Vāseṭṭha mahā-sammato, mahā-sammato tv eva paṭhamaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:21.2: Khettānaṃ patīti kho Vāseṭṭha khattiyo, khattiyo tv eva dutiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:21.3: Dhammena pare rañjetīti kho Vāseṭṭha rājā, rājā tv eva tatiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:21.4: Iti kho Vāseṭṭha evam etassa khattiyamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi. Tesaṃ ñeva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ sadisānaṃ ñeva no asadisānaṃ dhammen' eva no adhammena.
dn27:21.5: Dhammo hi Vāseṭṭha seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ diṭṭhe c' eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca. 22. ‘Tesaṃ
dn27:22.1: ñeva kho Vāseṭṭha sattānaṃ ekaccānaṃ etad ahosi:
dn27:22.2: "Pāpakā vata bho dhammā sattesu pātu bhūtā, yatra hi nāma adinnādānaṃ paññāyissati, garahā paññāyissati, musā-vādo paññāyissati, daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyissati, pabbājanaṃ paññāyissati.
dn27:22.3: Yan nūna mayaṃ pāpake akusale dhamme bāheyyāmāti."
dn27:22.5: "Pāpake akusale dhamme bāhentīti" kho Vāseṭṭha Brāhmaṇā, Brāhmaṇā tv eva paṭhamaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:22.6: Te araññāyatane paṇṇa-kuṭiyo karitvā paṇṇa-kuṭīsu jhāyanti, vītaṅgārā vīta-dhūmā paṇṇa-musalā sāyaṃ sāyam-āsāya pāto pātar-āsāya gāma-nigama-rājadhāniyo osaranti ghāsam esanā.
dn27:22.7: Te ghāsaṃ paṭilabhitvā punad eva araññāyatane paṇṇa-kuṭīsu jhāyanti.
dn27:22.8: Tam enaṃ manussā disvā evam āhaṃsu:
dn27:22.9: "Ime kho bho sattā araññāyatane paṇṇa-kuṭiyo karitvā paṇṇa-kuṭīsu jhāyanti, vītaṅgārā vīta-dhūmā paṇṇa-musalā sāyaṃ sāyam-āsāya pāto pātar-āsāya gāma-nigama-rājadhāniyo osaranti ghāsam esanā.
dn27:22.10: Te ghāsaṃ paṭilabhitvā punad eva araññāyatane paṇṇa-kuṭīsu jhāyanti.
dn27:22.11: "Jhāyantīti" kho pana Vāseṭṭha jhāyahā, jhāyakā tv eva dutiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ. 23.
dn27:23.1: ‘Tesaṃ ñeva kho Vāseṭṭha sattānaṃ ekacce sattā araññāyatane paṇṇa-kuṭīsu taṃ jhānaṃ anabhisambhuṇamānā gāma-sāmantaṃ nigama- sāmantaṃ osaritvā ganthe karontā acchenti.
dn27:23.2: Tam enaṃ manussā disvā evam āhaṃsu:
dn27:23.3: "Ime kho bho sattā araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu taṃ jhānaṃ anabhisambhuṇamānā gāma-sāmantaṃ nigama-sāmantaṃ osaritvā ganthe karontā acchenti. Na dān' ime jhāyanti.
dn27:23.4: "Na dān' ime jhāyantīti" kho Vāseṭṭha ajjhāyakā , ajjhāyakā tv eva tatiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:23.5: Hīna-sammataṃ kho pana Vāseṭṭha tena samayena hoti. Tad etarahi seṭṭha-sammataṃ.
dn27:23.6: Iti kho Vāseṭṭha evam etassa Brāhmaṇa-maṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi. Tesaṃ ñeva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ sadisānaṃ ñeva no asadisānaṃ dhammen' eva no adhammena.
dn27:23.7: Dhammo hi Vāseṭṭha seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ diṭṭhe c' eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca. 24. ‘Tesaṃ
dn27:24.1: ñeva kho Vāseṭṭha sattānaṃ ekacce sattā methuna-dhammaṃ samādāya vissuta-kammante payojesuṃ.
dn27:24.2: "Methuna-dhammaṃ samādāya vissuta-kammante payojentīti" kho Vāseṭṭha Vessā, Vessā tv eva akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:24.3: Iti kho Vāseṭṭha evam etassa Vessamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi. Tesaṃ ñeva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ sadisānaṃ ñeva no asadisānaṃ dhammen' eva no adhammena.
dn27:24.4: Dhammo hi Vāseṭṭha seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ diṭṭhe c' eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca. 25. ‘Tesaṃ
dn27:25.1: ñeva kho Vāseṭṭha sattānaṃ ye te sattā avasesā te luddācārā ahesuṃ. "Luddācārā khuddācārā ti"
dn27:25.2: kho Vāseṭṭha Suddā, Suddā tv eva akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:25.3: Iti kho Vāseṭṭha evam etassa Sudda-maṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi. Tesaṃ ñeva sattānam anaññesaṃ sadisānaṃ ñeva no asadisānaṃ dhammen' eva no adhammena.
dn27:25.4: Dhammo hi Vāseṭṭha seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ diṭṭhe c' eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca. 26.
dn27:26.1: ‘Ahu kho so Vāseṭṭha samayo yaṃ khattiyo pi sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, --
dn27:26.3: Brāhmaṇo pi sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, -"Samaṇo bhavissāmīti."
dn27:26.4: Vesso pi sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, -- "Samaṇo
dn27:26.5: bhavissāmīti." Suddo pi sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, --
dn27:26.7: Imehi kho Vāseṭṭha catūhi maṇḍalehi Samaṇa-maṇḍalassa abhinibbatti ahosi. Tesaṃ ñeva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ sadisānaṃ ñeva no asadisānaṃ dhammen' eva no adhammena.
dn27:26.8: Dhammo hi Vāseṭṭha seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ diṭṭhe c' eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca. 27.
dn27:27.1: ‘Khattiyo pi kho Vāseṭṭha kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā, manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā, micchā-diṭṭhiko, micchā-diṭṭhi-kamma-samādāna-hetu kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:27.5: pe . . . Samaṇo pi kho Vāseṭṭha kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā, manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā, micchā-diṭṭhiko, micchā-diṭṭhi-kammasamādāna-hetu kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati. 28.
dn27:28.1: ‘Khattiyo pi kho Vāseṭṭha kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā, manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā, sammādiṭṭhiko sammā-diṭṭhi-kamma-samādāna-hetu kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:28.5: pe . . . Samaṇo pi kho Vāseṭṭha kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā, manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā, sammā-diṭṭhiko, sammādiṭṭhi-kamma-samādāna-hetu kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. 29.
dn27:29.1: ‘Khattiyo pi kho Vāseṭṭha kāyena dvaya-kārī, vācāya dvaya-kārī, manasā dvaya-kārī, vītimissa-diṭṭhiko, vītimissa-diṭṭhi-kamma-samādāna-hetu kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sukha-dukkha-paṭisaṃ vedī hoti.
dn27:29.5: pe . . . Samaṇo pi kho Vāseṭṭha kāyena dvaya-kārī, vācāya dvaya-kārī, manasā dvaya-kārī vītimissa-diṭṭhiko vītimissa-diṭṭhi-kamma- samādāna-hetu kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sukha-dukkha-paṭisaṃvedī hoti. 30.
dn27:30.1: ‘Khattiyo pi kho Vāseṭṭha kāyena saṃvuto, vācāya saṃvuto, manasā saṃvuto, satannaṃ bodhi-pakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanam anvāya diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyati. Brāhmaṇo pi kho Vāseṭṭha . . . pe . . . Vesso pi kho Vāseṭṭha . . . pe . . . Suddo pi kho Vāseṭṭha . . . pe . . . Samaṇo pi kho Vāseṭṭha kāyena saṃvuto, vācāya saṃvuto, manasā saṃvuto, sattannaṃ bodhi-pakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanam anvāya diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyati. 31.
dn27:31.1: Vāseṭṭha catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo kata-karaṇīyo ohita-bhāro anuppatta-sadattho parikkhīṇa-bhava-saṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto, so nesaṃ aggam akkhāyati dhammen' eva no adhammena.
dn27:31.2: Dhammo hi Vāseṭṭha seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ diṭṭhe c' eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca. 32.
dn27:32.1: ‘Brahmunā p' esā Vāseṭṭha Sanaṃkumārena gāthā bhāsitā:
dn27:32.6: ‘Sā kho pan' esā Vāseṭṭha Brahmunā Sanaṃkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā atthasaṃhitā no anattha-saṃhitā anumatā mayā.
dn27:32.13: Attamanā Vāseṭṭha-Bhāradvājā Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti. Aggañña-
